title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions Alongside Other Allowances
content:
Two settings of each Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product describe how it sits beside the traveler's other entitlements: whether subscription bags are added on top of the fare brand's free bags rather than compared with them, and whether any part of the subscription price is refunded because the holder's Summit tier already includes the same benefit.

| Subscription | Subscription bags added on top of the fare brand's free bags | Part of the price refunded because the Summit tier already includes the same benefit |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | No | No |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | No | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | No | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | No | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | No | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | No | No |

For all six subscriptions both settings read No: subscription bags are compared with the fare brand's free bags, not added on top of them, and no part of any subscription price is refunded because the holder's Summit tier already includes the same benefit.
